title: Canonical goals board
description: Objective: implement the full Goals and Board IA with phase projections, truth chips, frontier summaries, blockers, waits, and bounded actions. Deliverable: standalone control-room goals/board modules. NOT in scope: graph canvas or client-derived state. Hard dependencies: Generated control-room client and Live control-room seam. Owned paths: apps/control-room/src/goals/** and apps/control-room/src/board/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test.
definitionOfDone: Board remains the default and maps all phases without losing canonical state.
Cards show truth/provenance, blockers, waits, budgets, leases, and only supplied actions.
Narrow-window and keyboard behavior matches the pinned spec.
taskRails: The standalone control room displays daemon truth and nextAllowedCommands; it never derives authority, readiness, or evidence strength.
Every fact is text/icon/color encoded, keyboard accessible, provenance-drillable, and honest under degraded data.
IDE adapters remain thin optional launch/discover/embed shells with no product logic. Keep modules below 400 lines; explicit owned paths only.

implementationPlan.description: TDD RED for the canonical board in board-surface.test.tsx. Build an independent exact-length corpus carrying sourceAggregate, exact phase fact, and separately supplied placement; include same-spelled aggregate states and deliberately contradictory phase/placement so a phase-folding implementation fails. Assert all five declared columns, exact phase/source preservation, Ready visible while loading but collapsed only after an authoritative loaded-empty lane, terminated hidden by default then shown only by the controlled filter, unknown placement retained in `cr.board.unmapped`, first ShellFrame render showing Board with zero `cr.graph.*`, and caller order without sorting/dedupe. For cards pin owner/lease state/epoch/expiry, renewal and activity silence as distinct facts, progress, latest claim, typed blocker and intentional wait owner/reason/recheck, per-card budget/basis, critical-path/slack, SUSPECT/held/disposition/qualification overlays exactly as supplied, one chip per fact, provenance callback IDs, duplicate/blank identities not dropping records, and hostile extra secret fields absent from DOM. Pin supplied frontier lanes READY_NOW/UNBLOCK_NEXT/INTENTIONAL_WAIT/UNSAFE_OR_UNKNOWN with cursor/graph epoch/idle capacity/readiness explanation, and the polite live join strip. Assert rendered action `(commandId, kind, target)` tuples exactly equal matching supplied context commands; empty/foreign-target contexts render none and disabled actions never activate.
implementationPlan.note: RED written: board-surface.test.tsx, 17 cases in 4 describes, 370 physical lines (headroom kept under the 400 cap for step 6's keyboard block). Independent hand-written corpus of 13 cards, asserted with `expect(CARDS.length).toBe(13)` and `expect(FRONTIER.length).toBe(4)` so no sweep can pass vacuously. The corpus is built to break a phase-folding implementation: same-spelled-a (PlanningRun/READY, placement plan) and same-spelled-b (WorkItem/READY, placement ready) spell the same state in different aggregates and different lanes, and `contradiction` carries phase EXECUTING with placement plan, so honoring placement is the only way to pass. Pins: five declared columns with column-major caller order equal to a hand-written VISIBLE_ORDER (duplicate nodeId rendered twice, blank identity as cr.board.card.UNKNOWN, no sort/dedupe), exact phase value plus data-source-aggregate preservation, unplaced record retained in cr.board.unmapped and absent from every column, terminated hidden by default with a controlled cr.board.filter.terminated that reports true but does not self-reveal, Ready still drawn while loading with five skeletons, Ready collapsed only via loadedEmptyColumns with exact collapse copy while executing keeps its "Nothing executing" hint, degraded as-of note with role="status", and first ShellFrame render showing cr.surface.board under cr.shell.main with zero cr.graph.* nodes. Card pins: the exact 23 declared fact kinds in order with exactly one cr.chip.* each; renewal silence "renewed 41s ago" and activity silence "quiet 41m" as two separate facts with the activity fact wrapped in the spec's cr.board.card.silence.{nodeId}; a 16-pair table (length-asserted) for owner/lease/progress/claim/typed blocker/intentional wait/budget+basis/critical path/slack; SUSPECT/held/disposition/qualification exactly as supplied with an absent qualification rendering UNKNOWN + data-origin="ABSENT"; node-qualified provenance callback ids; and a hostile card carrying sessionToken "shhh-bearer-secret" that must not appear anywhere in the DOM. Frontier pins all four supplied lanes READY_NOW/UNBLOCK_NEXT/INTENTIONAL_WAIT/UNSAFE_OR_UNKNOWN with cursor/graph epoch/idle capacity/readiness explanation (the unsafe lane's absent readiness stays UNKNOWN) plus the aria-live="polite" join strip with supplied summary and exact input identities. Action pins: rendered (commandId, kind, target) tuples exactly equal the two matching supplied context commands with the foreign-target command excluded, activation returns the identical frozen object (toBe), foreign-only and empty command sets render zero cr.action.* controls, and a mutationsEnabled=false snapshot leaves the control disabled with zero callbacks after two clicks. Confirmed RED for the right reason: `Error: Failed to resolve import "./board-surface.js" from "src/board/board-surface.test.tsx". Does the file exist?` (exit 1, no tests run).

implementationPlan.description: GREEN the board presentation in board-contract.ts, board-card.tsx, and board-surface.tsx. Define local presentation contracts (not wire DTOs) with SuppliedFact fields, opaque source aggregate/exact phase, daemon-supplied placement `plan|ready|executing|review|accepted|terminated|null`, controlled loading/degraded/terminated state, and readonly frontier/join/card arrays. BoardCard renders only named properties through FactRow, keeps renewal/activity silence and overlays orthogonal, composes shared target-scoped SuppliedActions, and uses index-qualified keys so malformed duplicate identities remain visible. BoardSurface renders column-major supplied order, five columns plus explicit unmapped/terminated regions, authoritative loaded-empty Ready collapse, per-column loading/empty hints, last-known degraded data, verbatim frontier/join summaries, and no phase mapping, readiness/frontier/budget/truth calculation, lifecycle rule, sorting, dedupe, optimistic transition, transport, or graph surface. Keep every production TS/TSX <=250 lines and turn the board RED suite green.
implementationPlan.note: GREEN: 18/18 in src/board/board-surface.test.tsx, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room typecheck` exit 0. board-contract.ts (105 lines) declares presentation contracts explicitly documented as NOT wire DTOs, with SuppliedFact fields, opaque sourceAggregate, exact phase, daemon-supplied placement plan|ready|executing|review|accepted|terminated|null, a separate actionTargetId (never derived from nodeId), controlled loading/degraded/showTerminated/loadedEmptyColumns state, and readonly frontier/join/card arrays. board-card.tsx (85 lines) renders only the 23 named properties through FactRow, keeps renewal and activity silence as two facts with the activity fact wrapped in cr.board.card.silence.{id}, keeps SUSPECT/held/disposition/qualification orthogonal, uses readIdentity so a blank identity renders as UNKNOWN rather than disappearing, and composes the shared target-scoped SuppliedActions. board-surface.tsx (194 lines) selects each lane by supplied placement only, renders column-major supplied order with index-qualified keys, five columns plus explicit unmapped and terminated regions, collapse gated on !loading && loadedEmpty && no cards (so unknown never collapses), per-column skeletons and empty hints, a degraded as-of note, and verbatim frontier lanes plus a polite join strip. Two corrections made while going green, both recorded: the card title test id was cr.board.card.title, which the prefix query counted as a card, so it is now cr.board.cardtitle; and the loading case now supplies loadedEmptyColumns: ["ready"] so the !loading guard is genuinely load-bearing instead of vacuously satisfied by an empty authoritative list. implementationPlan.description: TDD RED→GREEN for keyboard/narrow behavior and the authority boundary. Because jsdom does not apply viewport media queries, read the CSS from `process.cwd()` with a positive file anchor and pin `max-width: 959px`, overflow, and sticky declarations. Add goals-board-ban.test.ts with a nonzero exact canonical-production file set/import allow-list and bans on fixtures/data-adapter plus @moe/core/store/scheduler, lifecycle tables, and transition/authority derivation imports; assert the guard case count itself. Adversarial self-review and mutation proof. Load adversarial-self-review, then use OS-temp backups plus SHA-256 restoration for one-at-a-time production mutants: remove target filtering so a foreign affordance renders; relocate a card instead of honoring supplied placement; upgrade a missing fact to DAEMON_VERIFIED/zero; merge renewal with activity silence; invert terminated-default or loaded-empty Ready behavior; and force horizontal keyboard navigation to row 0. Each must make its named focused test red; assert every exercised corpus/sweep count is >0, restore exact bytes after every mutant, and leave no probe/scratch/generated evidence. Red-team null/blank/huge arrays, duplicate IDs, extra secret-shaped fields, disabled double activation, empty/nonuniform columns, absent provenance, and contradictory overlays; confirm no computed authority/readiness/evidence strength and that J1 files/dist/package/lockfile remain untouched. Run the single final verification gate in the foreground: `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`; record fresh file/test counts and exit 0 as completion evidence (the app-scoped test is mandatory because root Vitest skips apps). Then inspect `git status --porcelain`, unstage any foreign staged path without altering its worktree bytes, explicitly stage only the nine owned new paths, and commit only by explicit pathspec—never bare commit/add -A. Verify `git show --stat --oneline HEAD` contains exactly those paths and that both J1 files are absent from the diff.

planningNotes.risks: Rich goal/board wire DTOs do not yet exist, so comments and tests must call these presentation contracts—not daemon response schemas—and no unknown JSON parser may be invented. The exact phase and source aggregate must never be flattened; supplied placement may contradict phase and must still be shown exactly, while null/unknown placement goes to an explicit unmapped region rather than disappearing. NextAllowedCommand has no human/agent audience field, so the UI may target-filter only; it must not classify work.* or step.* itself. Missing command with no daemon reason is ABSENT, not a guessed refusal. CSS media behavior needs non-vacuous source assertions because jsdom does not evaluate viewport media queries. Use index-qualified React keys so duplicate/missing identities do not silently drop records. Nine files are deliberate responsibility splits under the ten-file hard cap; keep every production TS/TSX <=250 lines and every module <400.
